description: Split from task-59e1d1502a7b488387d6a6d2a10ff43a on 2026-11-07 (fleet host is macOS; those legs need Windows/WSL). Run on a Windows/WSL host: `node scripts/tests/copilot-smoke.mjs ps1` on Windows PowerShell 5.1 (original checkRefs[2]), and the WSL profile of scripts/tests/copilot-final-gate.sh (guards gate with 5.1 and pwsh 7 rows, gradlew.bat test via cmd.exe). definitionOfDone: `PASS copilot-smoke ps1` printed on Windows PowerShell 5.1: task REVIEW/DONE, every step COMPLETED, proof.txt equals canary, worker.type COPILOT on daemon record and board feed, Serena read_memory logged.

implementationPlan.description: Preflight and prepare the Windows/WSL proof without changing source. Keep the existing dependency on task-59e1d1502a7b488387d6a6d2a10ff43a; require its landed copilot-smoke.mjs, copilot-final-gate.sh and Copilot docs, not another worker's unlanded files. Read both drivers. Use a Windows-drive checkout under /mnt/<x> with WSL interop, bash, node, npm, git, tar, python3, timeout, wslpath, cmd.exe, Windows PowerShell 5.1, pwsh 7 and a working Windows JDK. The real ps1 smoke requires Windows Node (process.platform win32), Copilot installed and signed in on Windows, Serena installed, entitlement and third-party MCP access; WSL authentication is not Windows authentication. Prepare a separate Windows-native git-archive/clone snapshot outside the live checkout; on missing dependencies install from its lockfiles and build moe-proxy and moe-daemon there only. Do not mix WSL and Windows node_modules. Capture source revision and tool versions, not credentials. Required error handling: unavailable host/tools/access means one BLOCKED reason, no PASS, and report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds:[] for an external-host/access blocker. Source defects become separate bug tasks, not fixes here.

One verification/test evidence phase for DoD 1-2. From the built Windows snapshot, in Windows PowerShell 5.1, run exactly `node scripts/tests/copilot-smoke.mjs ps1`. Require exit 0 and PASS copilot-smoke ps1 with task REVIEW/DONE, every step COMPLETED, completion commit proof.txt equal to the canary, worker.type COPILOT in both daemon record and board feed, and a logged Serena memory read (legacy read_memory or REPL s.mem.read_memory). No fake CLI or macOS sh substitute. Separately, hold the jetbrains-gradle lease for the Windows-drive checkout and run exactly `timeout 1200s bash scripts/tests/copilot-final-gate.sh` under WSL: checkRefs[0] and the fresh complete_task verification command. Require exit 0, D/W/J/V/P passing, and bare PASS copilot-final-gate, not the macOS suffix. W covers bash/5.1/pwsh 7, parity/mutations and protected-command rows; J requires gradlew.bat test --rerun with fresh nonempty passing XML. The gate already runs npm in a snapshot and includes lint; do not run the full launcher postflight or duplicate the gate. Post both actual result lines with source revision, versions, elapsed time and return codes via moe.add_comment. Release the Gradle lease after its processes finish on all paths; interrupted WSL interop does not prove Windows Gradle stopped. Error handling: smoke BLOCKED exit 3, gate preflight exit 2, test failure and timeout are not success; retain safe logs, report the real blocker/defect, and do not weaken the drivers.

Update only scripts/CLAUDE.md's existing Copilot verification paragraph after the required evidence exists (DoD 3). Record the measured Windows PowerShell 5.1 verification date, CLI version, source revision and both PASS result summaries. Replace only this task's pending-Windows-proof statement; preserve macOS evidence, the distinction between full WSL PASS and macOS PASS-with-skips, all docs anchors, and the separate macOS vm-route portability follow-up. If either required run did not pass, do not claim Windows verification or remove its pending qualification. No wrapper, gate, smoke driver, IDE or daemon source changes belong here.

One final adversarial self-review and QA handoff of this task only. Confirm the diff contains only the intended scripts/CLAUDE.md evidence update; posted results and complete_task evidence identify the same source revision, actual Windows 5.1 engine and full WSL profile; no empty/stale/partial log or skipped leg was mistaken for PASS; credentials and environment values were not logged; unique scratch paths and recorded-PID cleanup cannot affect another seat; the gate met its 1200-second bound; and the Gradle lease is released after owned work ends. Review final documentation against captured results. Supply checkRefs[0]'s actual command/exitCode/outputTail to complete_task. QA repeats the exact required commands on a suitable Windows/WSL host, not a macOS substitute; defects require a separately scoped bug task.
